sources.entry: CapsLockNoDelay - Removes caps-lock key activation delay for fast typers. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/gkpln3/CapsLockNoDelay)

summary.one_liner: A small macOS background app that removes the built-in delay when pressing Caps Lock, aimed at fast typists.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes CapsLockNoDelay as a tool that removes the annoying delay when pressing Caps Lock on macOS. It runs in the background with no settings window or GUI, and can be seen in Activity Monitor. Setup involves adding the app to Login Items and granting it Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions in Security & Privacy. The README also documents a built-in alternative that needs no app: running hidutil property --set '{"CapsLockDelayOverride":0}' in Terminal. It can be installed by copying CapsLockNoDelay.app from releases or built from source, or via Homebrew cask. The README says it was confirmed working on macOS Sequoia 15.5.
use_cases: Remove Caps Lock press delay on Mac
Speed up typing on macOS keyboard
Run a background keyboard tweak at login
how_to_run: Try the built-in fix in Terminal: hidutil property --set '{"CapsLockDelayOverride":0}'
Manual install: download CapsLockNoDelay.app from releases (or compile from source) and copy it to /Applications
Add CapsLockNoDelay.app to System Preferences > General > Login Items
Grant CapsLockNoDelay.app Accessibility permission under Security & Privacy > Privacy
If present, grant CapsLockNoDelay.app Input Monitoring permission
notable: Has a built-in alternative using a single hidutil command, no app needed
Runs silently in the background with no GUI or settings
Confirmed working on macOS Sequoia 15.5 per the README
caveats: Requires granting Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions
README gives no details on other macOS versions beyond Sequoia 15.5
